dedupe_keys.name: agricultural baseline bl0 scenario of the 2016 billion ton report county level 2015 2040

description: This Oak Ridge National Laboratory dataset is the agricultural baseline scenario of the 2016 Billion-Ton Report (volume 1), the reference case for its biomass supply scenarios. The DataCite record says it runs from 2015 to 2040 with 2014 as starting year, was simulated with the POLYSYS agricultural policy model (University of Tennessee) without offering a farmgate price for energy crops or residues, building on the USDA 2015 baseline and the 2014 agricultural census, and gives text output files by year, simulation and county (codes 1 to 3109), with checks for negative values, harvested area above planted area and FIPS codes. It was issued in 2016 by Maggie Davis, Chad Hellwinckel, Laurence Eaton, Matthew Langholtz, Anthony Turhollow and Craig Brandt, with 7,965 rows, free to download from OSTI (licence not stated on the page read). Coverage is national by county. Caveats: it is a scenario, not observed data, and later Billion-Ton editions may supersede it. For simulation it gives county crop area, production, yield and cost projections for agricultural supply and bioenergy feedstock scenarios. Related catalogue records include MAgPIE, GLOBIOM and the USDA June survey data.
